content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lawrenceville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's credential handbook to verify you meet the baseline requirements for the PMP—this typically involves a combination of formal education and documented hours leading projects. Eligibility confirmation takes 10–15 minutes and prevents delays later.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Over several weeks, you'll study the PMBOK® Guide, project-management processes, and exam domains with active certified practitioners. Live instruction lets you ask questions in real time and work through case studies relevant to Construction, Healthcare, Government, and other sectors active in Lawrenceville's job market.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35 contact hours, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application. You'll document your education, work history, and project experience for PMI's review. Once approved, you'll pay the exam fee and receive authorization to schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, flashcards, and review sessions—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your computer-based exam at a local testing center. The PMP exam is proctored and tests your knowledge across project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing across diverse industries.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP credential is valid for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, speaking, publishing, or volunteer leadership in project management. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting your PDU record and renewal fee to PMI.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
